**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 17:23
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on how to maintain healthy hair.
- [CHANGE] User recently switched to a new shampoo and conditioner from a brand called "Green Earth."
- [FACT] Green Earth products use refillable packaging and are free of harsh chemicals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant congratulated the user on switching to a more eco-friendly hair care brand.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for maintaining healthy hair while using Green Earth products, including understanding hair type, using the right amount of product, shampooing wisely, conditioning thoroughly, using a wide-tooth comb, reducing heat styling, getting regular trims, protecting hair from the sun, being gentle when towel-drying, and being patient.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips included following product instructions, discontinuing use if sensitivity occurs, and considering a hair mask or deep conditioning treatment once a week.
- [EVENT] User has been using the Green Earth shampoo and conditioner for a week.
- [CHANGE] User has noticed their hair feels cleaner and looks shinier but is experiencing dryness at the ends.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided recommendations for hydrating hair masks and deep conditioning treatments that are eco-friendly and free of harsh chemicals, including:
  1. Coconut Oil Mask
  2. Avocado and Banana Mask
  3. Argan Oil and Aloe Vera Mask
  4. Green Earth Deep Conditioning Treatment
  5. Acure Deep Conditioning Mask
  6. Briogeo Don't Despair, Repair! Deep Conditioning Mask
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised doing a patch test before applying new products, applying masks after shampooing, using a wide-tooth comb for even distribution, and rinsing with shampoo afterward.
- [PREFERENCE] User is curious about other eco-friendly hair care practices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips on reducing hair waste, including getting regular trims, using a wide-tooth comb, avoiding heat styling, using a microfiber towel, sleeping on a satin pillowcase, being gentle when combing, avoiding harsh chemicals, using a hair serum or oil, protecting hair from the sun, and not over-washing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] General eco-friendly hair care tips included using shampoo and conditioner bars, choosing refillable products, buying in bulk, avoiding products with microbeads, and upcycling old hair care products.
- [PREFERENCE] User is trying to incorporate eco-friendly tips into their hair care routine.
- [CHANGE] User has been trying to reduce their use of single-use plastics in other areas of life.
- [EVENT] User started using reusable beeswax wraps instead of plastic wrap
